about.text: A viscous, salted, sour milk of Colombia’s Caribbean coast, made from raw milk that sours by itself and eaten with arepas and boiled yuca. Its name is the Spanish word for whey, but it is a soured whole milk.

processing.text: Raw cow milk soured by its native flora, with salt added. Yeasts rise early and lactic acid bacteria dominate by about 24 h; in a Cauca study L. paracasei and L. lactis at 30:70 or 40:60 gave least syneresis.
